title: Roasted Chicken Keto Delight
description: A low-carb dish featuring roasted chicken with a delicious and savory flavor profile. Perfect for keto dieters.
instructions: Rinse the chicken and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the chicken with thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken on all sides until browned, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a baking sheet.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 45-50 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Let the chicken rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
